title: Install and Extend Common ATLAS Release Safety Controls R001
summary: Install PC-024 strict same-origin Workbox URL comparison, PC-025 immutable Vercel no-auto-link preflight, and post-ready exact-head hosted-review quiescence as shared ATLAS release-safety controls.

metadata.publication_claim_boundary: The controls are installed and verified in local ATLAS evidence and present in this publication-held candidate; they are not installed on current main until this candidate is separately published and merged.
metadata.summary: Install PC-024 strict same-origin Workbox URL comparison, PC-025 immutable Vercel no-auto-link preflight, and post-ready exact-head hosted-review quiescence as shared ATLAS release-safety controls.
provenance: FA-027 / PC-024: Workbox relative versus root-relative same-origin comparison false negative
FA-028 / PC-025: unbound Vercel CLI diagnostic auto-linked a disposable project
Fitness PR #187: ready-triggered hosted review reported a valid unresolved P1 only after merge because preflight did not require post-ready completion
FawxzzyWeb PR #65: hosted review began at 2026-09-13T16:32:21Z and the exact head merged at 2026-09-13T16:32:25Z while that review remained running

reused: existing workflow baseline, governance registry, conformance validator, and Engineering Memory decision seams
atlas-release-gate exact-head identity, independent review, and separate ready-versus-merge lifecycle rules
rejected_as_incomplete: No existing shared strict same-origin Workbox canonicalizer preserved URL semantics plus byte and hash identity.
No existing shared Vercel gate combined immutable binding bytes, workspace identity, project and organization identity, reparse rejection, and command-profile classification before CLI invocation.

No existing merge preflight required positive completion from every named hosted reviewer on the exact head after the ready transition; an empty snapshot could therefore race future review publication.

explicitly_forbidden_in_common_gate: link, pull, dev, or deploy mutation surfaces
cli_evidence.discovery_boundary: CLI-specific profiles require fresh exact command help before expansion.

rules.text: Compare Workbox precache entries only after strict same-origin URL canonicalization, while retaining exact admitted query and fragment semantics, duplicate rejection, required coverage, and byte and SHA-256 identity.
Raw relative versus root-relative comparison can falsely reject equivalent same-origin Workbox entries and force a safe but unnecessary rollback.
Validate immutable local Vercel binding and a supported explicit command target before any linkage-capable CLI invocation; unknown or ambiguous command and binding surfaces fail closed.
An unbound diagnostic Vercel CLI command can mutate local linkage and create provider resources even when no deployment is intended.

After a draft-to-ready transition bound to the exact immutable head, require positive terminal completion from every named hosted reviewer strictly later in that ready epoch before merge; queued or in-progress attempts, completed findings, and unresolved non-outdated current threads fail closed while explicitly outdated historical threads do not block.
A pre-ready clean result or initially empty review snapshot can race a hosted review started by the ready transition, allowing merge before that review reports a valid finding.
